verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs list "audit logs" among its enterprise security features and mention "versioned forecasts". That gives a thin, first-party basis for change tracking and versions, but nothing describes who/what/when detail for model edits or any rollback. Missing for 10: documented per-change attribution (user, field, timestamp) for model edits, an explicit rollback/restore capability, in-depth audit-log docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
